# Oguz Ozgul

> GTM strategy and operations leader based in Amsterdam, open to relocating to New York or San Francisco. 13 years across global enterprises and high-growth B2B SaaS (Philips, Amgen, Mambu, Airbyte, HiBob). Builds the operating model behind revenue teams (pipeline, forecasting, territories, routing) and the AI tooling that runs it. Founder of Emport.

## Selected results

- HiBob: shared lifecycle stages and SLAs adopted by 150+ GTM staff; 18 A/B-tested Outreach sequences lifted the SDR meeting rate 20%; AI-written account briefs for every new lead
- Airbyte: rebuilt lead scoring and routing, with 27% fewer unworked MQLs and lead-to-first-activity up 20%
- Mambu: built a campaign operations center of excellence, with 3x campaign velocity and QA errors under 3%
